# compass index

Start with `compass resume`: current-state, live global claims, uncommitted work.
Records below are live; search all of .compass/ with `rg -i <term> .compass/`.

## global (delivered by `compass resume`)
- [2026-10-21-disposable-sessions](goals/2026-10-21-disposable-sessions.md) — Disposable sessions: any agent, Claude or not, resumes the work without a discovery phase

## decisions
- [0019-search-the-records-before-changing-behaviour](decisions/0019-search-the-records-before-changing-behaviour.md) — The AGENTS.md block tells agents to search the records with rg before changing behaviour; no search command is built
- [0018-one-choice-per-record](decisions/0018-one-choice-per-record.md) — One choice per record, its claim naming it; supersede only when the old claim is untrue, and record says what it retires
- [0017-narrow-decision-recording](decisions/0017-narrow-decision-recording.md) — Record a decision only for real alternatives a later agent could undo, with its why; an empty-bodied record warns
- [0016-current-state-is-last-known-intent](decisions/0016-current-state-is-last-known-intent.md) — current-state is last known intent: objective and next steps only, never a plan; git and the user's current prompt win over it
- [0015-scope-cut](decisions/0015-scope-cut.md) — compass owns only the why, the why-not and where-we-are: v2 skills, hooks, session tools, learnings and layout-drift are cut; restates 0014 as built
- [0013-plugin-is-a-subdirectory-with-reproducible-binaries](decisions/0013-plugin-is-a-subdirectory-with-reproducible-binaries.md) — the plugin is ./plugin (launcher in bin/, binaries in libexec/), built reproducibly so CI byte-checks the committed binaries
- [0012-staleness-is-code-commits-after-current-state](decisions/0012-staleness-is-code-commits-after-current-state.md) — current-state is stale when code commits exist after the later of its in-history anchor and its last commit; stale warns locally and fails only CI (--require-fresh)

## experiments
- [2026-10-26-v3-field-week](experiments/2026-10-26-v3-field-week.md) — v3 field week on ebay-flipper (2026-10-26 to 10-30): orientation, current-state upkeep, decision reads and overhead from real transcripts, bars set before the week
- [2026-10-26-claude-signal-search-line](experiments/2026-10-26-claude-signal-search-line.md) — Claude signal test of the search line in CLAUDE.md and the brief: new and old arms both honour 6/6, new finds the record at call 1–2 vs 2–8; no-compass reversed the tempting task
- [2026-10-22-retrieval-q2-keywords](experiments/2026-10-22-retrieval-q2-keywords.md) — Blind graded query set for decision retrieval: do ranking hygiene and a record-side keywords line close the gap to BM25's ceiling?
- [2026-10-22-one-choice-rerun](experiments/2026-10-22-one-choice-rerun.md) — Targeted Codex re-run of decision 0018: the tax-base choice gets its own record instead of folding into integer cents
- [2026-10-22-decision-recording-rerun](experiments/2026-10-22-decision-recording-rerun.md) — Targeted Codex re-run of decision 0017: trivia no longer recorded, real decisions still recorded with a body, no rounding regression
- [2026-10-22-codex-core-operations-eval](experiments/2026-10-22-codex-core-operations-eval.md) — Codex eval of compass's core operations (orient, handoff, drift, decision write, decision read) against no-compass arms, after the scope cut
- [2026-10-21-v3-core-eval](experiments/2026-10-21-v3-core-eval.md) — v3 core eval on an ebay-flipper copy: resume cost, discovery overhead with and without compass, and a Claude-to-Codex mid-task handoff
